upi_scam.description: Unauthorized debits via UPI collect requests, fraudulent QR code scans, or spoofed payment receipts.

otp_fraud.description: Deceptive phone calls impersonating bank/KYC officials to manipulate victims into sharing OTPs or card details.

phishing.description: Deceptive URLs and messages mimicking utility companies, couriers, or government agencies to steal credentials or payments.

fake_loan_app.description: Unregulated instant loan apps using invasive device permissions to blackmail victims and demand extortionate repayments.

investment_scam.description: Work-from-home tasks or fake investment schemes promising guaranteed high returns to elicit large deposits into mule accounts.

sim_swap.description: Unauthorized acquisition of duplicate SIM or eSIM transfer to hijack phone numbers and intercept banking SMS OTPs.

unknown.description: General or unclassified cyber financial fraud requiring incident intake and preliminary investigation.
